notes.title: Update 2.7.2
notes.content:
[h3][u]Version 2.7.2[/u]
[/h3][p]This update comes mostly with [b]Steam[/b] updates in mind. We’ve added [b]three new achievements[/b] and a total of [b]33 Steam stats[/b] that will come into play later on. But, they’re hidden so, you’ll have to play to discover what they are. [/p][p][/p][p]We’ve removed all previous client held settings, now to be handled specifically by Steam Stats and Achievements. Most game functionality now requires Steam to progress into the game. The only thing remaining are the client specific settings like volume and camera controls. [/p][p][/p][p][u]Gameplay Changes[/u] [/p][list][*][p]The length of time for a match was reduced from 8min to 5min. This doesn't include the amount of time that is added as you eat objects (which only adds a very tiny amount of time for every object you eat).,[/p][/*][*][p]Abilities now persist between matches. If you collect an ability in a previous run it now begins enabled on the next round.[/p][/*][*][p]You now are required to play the levels in sequence. Once you finish the tutorial you can play the Farm level, and after the Farm the Beach becomes available etc. This was the intended game play progression from the start, but it was glossed over in our rush to complete the title on time. Now that we have the luxury of time we want to make sure it has all it’s intended features.,[/p][/*][/list][p] [/p][p][u]Bug Fixes[/u] [/p][list][*][p]We’ve made a few bug changes, mostly related to the new Steam integration.,[/p][/*][*][p]Some collectable images weren’t showing properly, or showing doubles in the tutorial for example.,[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]The next updates will be more frequent, and hopefully more gameplay related. [/p][p]More to come, stay tuned![/p]

notes.title: v2.7 Steam Leaderboard integration!
notes.content:
We've added [b]Leaderboards[/b] (finally!) to the game!

We hope to include PlayerStats and some new achievements in the next few weeks, but with our next title nearing completion there is no guarantee it will happen in a timely matter.

For now, enjoy getting those high scores!

notes.title: Hotfix 2.6.4
notes.content:
Updates: Jan 28th, 2024
☑️ v2.6.4.0

[u]Bug fixes[/u]
[list]
[*] Current mass slider now shows the proper position on the slider as your player grows
[*] Jump ability height has been corrected

[/list]

notes.title: Major update v2.6
notes.content:
[u][b]Achievements![/b][/u]

We've added a number of [u]changes, bug fixes and balance updates[/u]. The biggest addition is 5 new achievements that can be collected while playing.

[b]Assets[/b]
•	Added rigid body to some objects so they will fall naturally when the object they are on is absorbed
•	Lowered the streetlight tier from 2 to 1
•	Updated the render distance on some objects to appear more naturally instead of “popping” into view
•	Removed some objects in some levels that didn’t work as intended
•	Replaced the toon shader with a more performance friendly version instead of individual materials on objects
•	Moved the floating score, as it was previously blocking the play screen
•	Reduced some of the post effects (bloom and ambient occlusion)

[b]Level 1[/b]
•	Added more wind turbines
•	Balanced some of the corn field assets
•	Created a more chaotic scene with cars
•	Removed a large portion of trees from the map

[b]Level 2[/b]
•	All roads on bridges are now delete when the bridge is eaten
•	Removed a large portion of trees from the map

[b]Level 3[/b]
•	Added wind turbines to the map (Tier 5 objects)
•	Created a more chaotic scene with cars

[b]Bugs[/b]
•	Reduced sorting priority for water, was previously rendering through trees
•	Removed grass terrain textured objects
•	Fixed an issue with the mass slider not accurately reflecting the current mass of the player
•	Fixed missing textures on some objects that got removed accidentally
•	Stuck button no longer works after the game has ended
•	Fixed an issue with the UI causing the screen to shake

[b]Balance[/b]
•	Increased speed ability and overall speed at Tier 4/5
•	Increased the stuck button/killbox spawn height (may increase it based on the current players tier)
•	Time is no longer added to the clock at tier 4/5

[b]Miscellaneous additions[/b]
•	Added a stuck/spawn button, in case the player falls through the map or gets stuck on anything

[b]Achievements[/b]
•	Added 5 steam achievements
•	One for each first time collecting abilities (Tank, Jump, Speed)
•	Finish a round for the first time
•	Eating the sloth statue in the city level

notes.title: Updated notes for v2.5.2
notes.content:
[b]Updated game functionality includes:[/b]
- Reduced gravity
- Increased jump height
- Shader draw priority changes
- Added a killbox below the map, players will not be teleported back above the map should they fall through somehow
- Added a "stuck" button to the menu, for obvious reasons
- Added LOD groups to unrender distant objects that cause unnecessary frame loss.

More updates to come soon, and a big update to graphics/shaders/performance!

notes.title: Update 2.4.4.0
notes.content:
We increased performance on all maps, primarily on the beach, where frame rates suffered a dip when looking across large distances of assets.

While this is a small update, it will have a big impact on how the game plays on all computers, including older systems that required Vsync to be enabled, but no longer should it be necessary.

The illusive 60fps with 12,000 assets loaded at all times.

notes.title: Hotfix #1
notes.content:
Like any good indie dev, we wouldn't be complete without a hotfix for an update.

Corrections:
- Screen got stuck when pressing play for the first time
- Adjusted starting camera setting values for the 10th time.
- Reduced scene transition tool tips to direct players to the settings menu

More to come.
